title: The orchestrator checks staged .claude/ edits after copying them back, before land
goal: kb-sprint run step 3 (the headless delegation paragraph) and kb/_self/backlog.md Running a sprint say that after the orchestrator copies a headless worker's staging copies back into the worktree it runs python3 _tools/selfdoc.py check and the item's own checks there, before the commit and land, since the worker's checks read the worktree's unchanged .claude/ files, not the copies it edited; the rule is a tested question of kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv in set kb-sprint:run. From the SP-pbekfhaz retrospective: ST-zzsbdbi7's worker reported selfdoc problems=0 while its staged kb-sprint text held a dead heading reference.

run: import re,subprocess as sp,sys;P=lambda *a:sp.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','pack','--root','_self',*a],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout;m=re.search(r'coverage: good \(tested question (\S+):',P('after copying a headless worker staging copies back, which checks does the orchestrator run before land'));ok=bool(m) and ('# %s:'%m.group(1)) in P('--set','kb-sprint:run');print(m.group(1) if m else 'no tested question',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
